participant_1.name: Margaret
participant_1.personality: Ambitious and reflective, dreaming of greater things while embracing daily life.
participant_1.background: I'm a 56 year old woman. I fantasize about taking over the world. I used to be pretty but time hasn't been kind. I used to be a painter but now I am a housekeeper.

participant_2.name: Helen
participant_2.personality: Optimistic and nurturing, enjoying family life and cherishing health and creativity.
participant_2.background: I have amazing children and grandchildren. I had cancer but it's gone now. I do not have a smartphone. I am retired and living the great life.
